title: More Chat History (NeoForge port)
description: Increases the maximum length of chat history.
body:
# More Chat History - Unofficial NeoForge Port

**A simple client-side mod that increases the chat history limit in Minecraft.**

By default, Minecraft's chat history is limited, meaning older messages disappear as new ones arrive. This mod increases that limit, allowing you to scroll back and read much older messages without them being deleted.

> ⚠️ **Unofficial Port**
> 
> This is an unofficial **NeoForge** port of the popular [More Chat History](https://modrinth.com/mod/morechathistory) mod originally created by *JackFred*. All credits for the original idea and code logic go to them. If you are looking for the Fabric version, please check the original project page.

## Features

- **Increased Chat Scrolling:** Never lose track of older messages, server links, or coordinates shared in chat.
- **Purely Client-Side:** Works on any server, multiplayer network, or singleplayer world. No server-side installation required!
- **Lightweight & Safe:** Uses clean mixins to adjust the chat buffer without heavy performance drops or anti-cheat triggers.

## Requirements

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.4
- **Loader:** NeoForge

## Compatibility Notes

Since this is an unofficial port, please do not report issues found in this build to the original authors. If you experience crashes, log spam, or broken chat behavior, please report it directly using the contact links below.

## Credits

- **Original Mod:** [More Chat History](https://modrinth.com/mod/morechathistory)
- **Original Authors:** JackFred
